limitations: First equiv_simple left a ROM-related internal point unproven. First all-output SAT attempt rejected an unmapped ROM before solving. Final all-output miter explicitly memory-maps the original combinational ROM; arbitrary-input source equivalence passes and wrong-sum control fails.

An unconstrained source-to-mapped comparison already fails for the original ALU when multdiv selection overlaps the subtraction-select condition in the upstream unique-case operand mux. This failed baseline check is preserved, not waived. The independent mapped-original versus mapped-prefix comparison passes for all input combinations.

Isolated timing uses identical buf4 drive,5fF loads,20ns virtual clock,zero external delays,0.95/1.05derates and zero wire parasitics. HistoricalABC target20ps is identical in both mappings; no timing constraint is relaxed.

Whole-source control synthesis exactly reproduces the prior full-interface control netlist byte for byte with originalYosys0.67+146. Candidate differs only in the isolated ALU source path before mapping.

Full unplaced STA is dominated by unbuffered clock/reset fanouts (thousands of pins) and remains severely negative. Its numbers are not physical timing predictions or closure. Initial macro-LEF omission is preserved as an error before successful six-corner-case rerun.

Full native boot and fresh physical implementation are separately queued/running and are not accepted by this receipt. Full-chip SRAM transistor LVS, final routed timing, PVT/RC/fill and product gates remain open.
